name: nasq Platform
description: Complete-policy revision of the platform composition baseline. Every tier inherits the core tier's limit set, which now includes an explicit zero branch ceiling (limit:branches.extra_limit:0, default-deny) next to the two operator-set limits. Names, prices and other numeric ceilings remain pending decisions.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.description: Base modules only: the platform, its capability catalog and the shared API.

tiers.name: Projects
tiers.description: Adds the project and meeting pillar over the base modules.

tiers.name: People
tiers.description: Adds the HR pillar over the base modules.

tiers.name: Messaging
tiers.description: Adds the member-private chat pillar over the base modules.
